title: Western Blotting Protocol
author: Yuan Yao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qaddsa6
materials: Sit on Room Temperature for 20 min.
Develop the membrane with ChemiDoc MP Imaging system (BIO-RAD).

steps.title: Culture E. coli cells
steps.instruction: Incubate E. coli cells at a 1:100 dilution in 10 ml LB medium containing antibiotics.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells when OD600 reaches 0.4 and wash them.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge cells at 8000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C

steps.title: Prepare protein extract
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet and lyse via sonication.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a new 1.5 ml tube and keep on ice

steps.title: Run SDS-PAGE gel
steps.instruction: Load the sample into a 12% SDS-PAGE gel and run at 200V for 45 min.

steps.title: Prepare membrane and gel for transfer
steps.instruction: Equilibrate the PVDF membrane, filter paper, and gel in the appropriate buffers.

substeps.instruction: Immerse PVDF membrane in methanol for 5s
Transfer PVDF membrane into transfer buffer
Immerse filter paper in transfer buffer

steps.title: Transfer proteins to membrane
steps.instruction: Perform the membrane transfer at 25 V for 30 min.

steps.title: Block the membrane
steps.instruction: Block the membrane with 5% skim milk at room temperature (RT) for 1 hour.

steps.title: First wash sequence
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane with 1* PBST three times.

steps.title: Incubate with secondary antibody
steps.instruction: Incubate the membrane with Ab2 for 1 hour.

steps.title: Second wash sequence
steps.instruction: Wash the membrane with 1* PBST three times.

steps.title: Develop the membrane
steps.instruction: Prepare the detection solution and apply it to the membrane.

substeps.instruction: Mix solution 1 and 2 in a 1:1 ratio
Incubate the membrane with the mixed solution for 5 s
